h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ballia

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ballia

items.pText: Ballia is the easternmost district town of Uttar Pradesh, where the Ganga and the Ghaghara meet near the Bihar border. Most playground enquiries from towns of this size come from private schools, coaching campuses and a few residential colonies. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km from Ballia, and sends it by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

A school in Ballia rarely sets out to build a full playground in one go. More often the management has a budget for this year and wants to add more pieces later. That approach works well if the first layout is planned for the finished ground. We draw the full plan with every safe play area marked, then you pick which pieces to buy first. Later additions slot into spaces already kept free, so nothing has to be moved.

items.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages?
items.a: Yes. We prepare a full layout first and mark the safe play area for every piece. You buy the first set now and add the rest later without moving anything already installed.

items.q: Which pieces should a small school buy first?
items.a: Swings, a see-saw and a slide suit most primary sections because several children can use them together. Share the age groups and number of students, and we will suggest a first list.

items.q: Is the warranty the same for later additions?
items.a: Yes. Each piece carries 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, counted from its own installation.
